By route: named roster 6 substantive; bibliography chasing from the Fedwren Project 3 (Kok's MA thesis, Oliver's Mythlore article, the Fedwren Project itself); lateral searches 8 (Hobb's own 2017 Phantastik-Couch interview in its English original and its German rendering, the Penhaligon Lektorat interview, Paola Cartoceti's own translator page, the Spanish Nocturna announcement, the Manuel de los Reyes interview and his collected-reviews page, one reader review); 4 fetched and found non-substantive after a full read (Ekman and Taylor 2021, which does not treat Hobb at all; the second de los Reyes interview; the Elbakin Hobb interview; Chandarana at abstract level). Stopped when the roster was exhausted and the last two lateral searches surfaced one usable source and then none; the session web-search budget then ran out.
